issue: What is the leave policy for staff at ACIPL?
resolution: The leave policy at ACIPL includes various types of leaves such as Earned Leave, Special Medical Leave, Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, ESIC Sick Leave, ESIC Miscarriage Leave, Compensatory Leave, and Leave Without Pay.

issue: How do I apply for leave at ACIPL?
resolution: Leaves can be applied for through the HfactoR portal, and the manager's approval is required for the leave to be sanctioned.

issue: What is the eligibility for Earned Leave at ACIPL?
resolution: Every staff employee is given a maximum of 30 days of earned leave credit for every completed year of service on a pro-rata basis.

issue: How do I encash my leaves at ACIPL?
resolution: Annual leaves accumulated beyond 90 days can be encashed by giving an application to that effect, and the encashment will happen at the rate of the last drawn basic pay.

issue: What is the policy for Special Medical Leave at ACIPL?
resolution: Special Medical Leave can be availed when a prolonged leave is required to recover from illnesses, and it is mandatory to have an attachment of a doctor's certificate or consultation copy when applying for Special Medical Leave.

issue: What is the policy for Maternity Leave at ACIPL?
resolution: All married women can take Maternity Leave, and they are entitled to 26 weeks (182 days) of paid leave for up to 2 kids.

issue: What is the policy for Paternity Leave at ACIPL?
resolution: Married men with up to 2 kids can avail of 3 days of paternity leave within 30 days (1 month) after childbirth.

issue: What is the policy for ESIC Sick Leave at ACIPL?
resolution: Employees covered under ESIC can avail of up to 91 days of sick leave during 2 consecutive benefit periods at 70% of their average daily wages.

issue: What is the policy for ESIC Miscarriage Leave at ACIPL?
resolution: Women employees covered under ESIC can avail of up to 42 days of miscarriage leave to heal and return to work.

issue: What is the policy for Compensatory Leave at ACIPL?
resolution: Employees can avail of compensatory leave if they have worked on weekends or public holidays, and the leave must be taken within 30 days of the day when additional work was done.

issue: What is the policy for Leave Without Pay at ACIPL?
resolution: Employees can apply for Leave Without Pay only if they have exhausted all other leaves, and the leave will be valid only upon approval from the manager.

issue: Whom do I contact for leave-related queries at ACIPL?
resolution: The HRBP/Centre HR should be contacted for any leave-related queries.

issue: How do I access the Hfactor portal at ACIPL?
resolution: The Hfactor portal can be accessed through the link: https://myportal.hfactor.app/hrsuite/#/login/allen

issue: Can I apply for half-day leave at ACIPL?
resolution: No, leave application can only be for full day.

issue: Can I avail of maternity or paternity leave in tranches at ACIPL?
resolution: No, maternity or paternity leave cannot be availed in tranches.

issue: How will my leaves be credited during and after the probationary period at ACIPL?
resolution: For staff on probation, there are no earned leave balances, and the leave balance will be credited only after confirmation on 1st April.

issue: What happens if I don't receive a confirmation for my leave application at ACIPL?
resolution: If the leave remains unapproved on the system, it will be considered 'Leave Without Pay' or absent.

issue: When can I take 'Leave Without Pay' at ACIPL?
resolution: Leave Without Pay can be taken only if all other leaves have been exhausted.

issue: When is 'Loss of Pay' applied at ACIPL?
resolution: Loss of Pay is applied if an employee fails to mark their presence on a workday and does not apply for regularization before the 24th of any month.

resolution: No, it is not mandatory to take maternity leave 6 weeks before the date of delivery, but it can be taken anytime before the date of delivery.

resolution: No, special medical leave is not considered for the performance appraisal period.

issue: What is the policy for privilege leaves?

issue: Can I avail of maternity or paternity leave in tranches?
resolution: No, maternity and paternity leaves cannot be availed in tranches.

issue: How will my leaves be credited during and after the probationary period?
resolution: During probation, 1 leave is credited at the beginning of each month. After completion, remaining earned leaves are calculated on a pro-rata basis.

issue: What is the policy for management leaves?
resolution: Employees are eligible for 6 days of management leave in a financial year, credited after completion of the probationary period on a pro-rata basis.

issue: Can I encash my management leaves?
resolution: No, management leaves cannot be encashed.

issue: How do I contact HR for leave-related queries?
resolution: Contact the HRBP/Centre HR for any leave-related queries.

issue: What is the policy for bereavement leave?
resolution: 6 days of bereavement leave can be availed in the event of the demise of a family member. It can be availed multiple times.

issue: Can I apply for a half-day leave?
resolution: Yes, for some types of leave, half-day leave can be applied. Check the category to understand if half-day leave is available.

issue: What is the policy for compensatory leave?
resolution: Compensatory leave can be availed if work extends beyond working hours. It must be taken within 60 days of the day when additional work was done.

issue: What is the policy for transfer leave?
resolution: 3 days of transfer leave can be availed when being transferred from one city to another.

issue: What is the policy for leave without pay?
resolution: Leave without pay can be availed only if all other leaves have been exhausted. It requires approval from the Head HR Operations.

issue: How do I avail of management leaves?
resolution: Discuss them with your manager as only they can release your management leaves.

issue: Can management leaves be taken in tranches?
resolution: Yes, but the maximum number of management leaves in a year cannot exceed 6 in total.

issue: Can management leaves be encashed?
resolution: No, management leaves cannot be encashed.

issue: What is the policy for bereavement leave?
resolution: You are encouraged to avail bereavement leave each time you grieve the loss of a family member.

issue: I have applied for leave but have not received a confirmation yet. Can I still go ahead and take the leave?
resolution: No, please ensure your manager approves your leave before you go for the leave. If your leave remains unapproved on the system, it will be considered leave without pay.

issue: When can I take 'Leave Without Pay'?
resolution: In a financial year, if you end up exhausting all the leaves credited to you, you will be required to take leave without pay if necessary.

issue: When is 'Loss of Pay' applied?
resolution: Failing to mark your presence on a workday and if it is not applied for regularisation on before 24th of any month, will result in loss of pay.

issue: Is it mandatory to take maternity leave 8 weeks before the date of delivery?
resolution: No, it is not mandatory. You can choose to take your maternity leave any time before the date of delivery.

issue: What happens to my annual leaves between January to March of 2024?
resolution: Annual Leave (AL) pro-rated till March end will be added to the new leave balance from 1st April, if not consumed already.

issue: How can I apply for special medical leave?
resolution: You can apply for special medical leave when it is necessary to support you during your prolonged illness after exhausting all your other leave types. This leave type must be approved by your manager and Corporate HR once applied.

issue: Is special medical leave considered for the performance appraisal period?
resolution: No, performance will be evaluated and rated only for the period during which you have actively contributed to the organization.

issue: When can I encash my leave?
resolution: Privilege leaves accumulated up to 60 days can be encashed at the time of retirement or separation (subject to completion of Notice period).
